{{Quote|Orman is the romantic, I am not.|Silas Tagge|<ref name="marvel33">[[Star Wars (1977) 33|''Star Wars'' (1977) 33]]</ref>}}
'''Silas Tagge''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who helmed the research wing of the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Although he was born into the powerful and ancient [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]], Silas was wholly uninterested in anything outside of his scientific pursuits, living a simple and frugal lifestyle. When his older brother [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman]] became the new [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] of House Tagge, he put Silas' talents to use developing weapons in the Tagges' efforts to curry favor with the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]]. Among Tagge's creations was [[Achtnak Turbine Station]], which the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] used to devastating effect during the [[Yavin blockade]] of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] before its destruction by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. In the wake of that defeat, Tagge developed another weapon called the [[Omega Frost/Legends|Omega Frost]], with which he and his brother planned to freeze an entire Rebel fleet. However, Skywalker foiled that plot as well, leading to the Tagges' crushing defeat at the [[Battle of the Corridor]]. Tagge was ultimately placed into custody by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and later died while held by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The plan now depends upon my creation... not my older brother.|Silas Tagge, before the Battle of the Corridor|<ref name="marvel34">[[Star Wars (1977) 34|''Star Wars'' (1977) 34]]</ref>}}
[[File:TaggeBros.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Silas Tagge (right) with his brother Orman during Omega Frost testing on Tatooine.]]
A native of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]], Silas Tagge was born into the ancient and wealthy [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]], the owners and operators of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] megacorporation known as the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]. While his brothers were consumed with worldly concerns from a young age&mdash;his older brother [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman]] was groomed his entire life to become their house's next [[Baron/Legends|Baron]], while two younger brothers, [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio]] and [[Ulric Tagge/Legends|Ulric]], embarked on careers in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Military]]&mdash;Silas was a natural-born [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and developed few other interests.<ref name="geonosis" /> Tagge quickly developed into an accomplished [[Physicist/Legends|physicist]] and [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]], and the Tagge Company made use of his talents by placing him at the head of its research wing, which included clandestine weapons development facilities and pharmaceutical labs. The department flourished under Tagge's direction, becoming one of the galaxy's top scientific braintrusts and recruiting a level of talent only rivaled by the Empire itself.<ref name="intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>

The Tagges worked with the Empire during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], during which time Silas developed a design for a unique weapon to torment the upstart [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]: a massive turbine that could hide within the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] and generate a launch corridor for [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] runs out of seemingly nowhere. Silas first approached the Empire with the concept only to have it summarily dismissed, leading Orman to take up the idea and pour millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] into making it reality. The [[Space station/Legends|station]]&mdash;named [[Achtnak Turbine Station]], after a [[Achtnak|predator]] native to Tepasi&mdash;was complete by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], when it played a part in the Imperial [[Yavin blockade|blockade]] of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] in the wake of the Rebellion's famous victory at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="geonosis" />

Achtnak Turbine Station was ultimately destroyed by a young Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] named [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]],<ref name="marvel26">[[Star Wars (1977) 26|''Star Wars'' (1977) 26]]</ref> forcing Tagge to move onto a new project: a new weapon called the [[Omega Frost/Legends|Omega Frost]], which had the ability to flash-freeze any object or living being that contained [[Water/Legends|moisture]]. Silas and Orman tested the Omega Frost in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], finding that the device was potent enough to render even that planet's harsh and arid landscape a frozen wasteland. However, Orman had an ulterior motive for choosing Tatooine: it was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Skywalker, with whom he'd been spoiling for an opportunity to get even.<ref name="marvel31" /> Sure enough, the Omega Frost tests drew the attention of Skywalker,<ref name="marvel32">[[Star Wars (1977) 32|''Star Wars'' (1977) 32]]</ref> who had returned home in order to find [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] skilled enough to run the Yavin blockade.<ref name="marvel31" /> The Tagges attempted to spring a trap on Skywalker and his confederates [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], but the Rebels managed to escape in a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] and slip back to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="marvel32" />

[[File:Capsuledroids.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Silas and Orman Tagge during their imprisonment by Darth Vader.]]
With their tests on Tatooine completed, the two Tagge brothers departed the planet in a TaggeCo [[Mining Explorer]]. Although the meddlesome Skywalker was not in hand, they felt the time had come to enact a larger plan they hoped would decimate the Rebel fleet and earn the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor's]] favor. Their destination was [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]], where they rendezvoused with their brother Ulric and set up the Omega Frost in the nearby [[Feswe Corridor]]&mdash;they planned to lure a Rebel fleet into the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] and annihilate them with their new weapon, with Ulric's Imperial battle group waiting in reserve. Skywalker and company followed the Tagges to Junction, but the young Rebel was captured investigating the Omega Frost's implementation. Silas took command of the [[Battle of the Corridor|operation]] with Orman fixated on Skywalker, but the scientist still had to keep watch on his brother: when Silas learned that Orman intended to engage Skywalker in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] duel, Silas ensured that the Rebel's only possible escape vessel was a defueled [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] that had been stripped of all arms and communications. Skywalker defeated Orman in their encounter, his skill with the blade proving to be so great that the Baron was incapacitated with shock.<ref name="marvel33" />

Silas' alterations ensured that Skywalker was stranded in a listing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], although the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] man miraculously managed to reach one of the Omega Frost's conductor towers as the Rebel ships approached the zone of attack. When Tagge realized Skywalker's location, the scientist rashly ordered the Omega Frost activated too early, with the Rebels just outside of its effective range. Meanwhile, Skywalker destroyed the device's conductor, ruining the Omega Frost's ambient effect. Panicked by his failure, Silas fled the Mining Explorer's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and rushed to Orman's side, desperately hoping his older brother had a plan to save them. However, the Rebel ships closed in at that moment, destroying the Mining Explorer and sending the Tagge brothers adrift.<ref name="marvel34" /> Although most believed Silas and Orman dead, they were picked up by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who kept them on [[Life support capsule|life support]] aboard his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and later used them as leverage to secure the obedience of Ulric Tagge.<ref name="marvel35">[[Star Wars (1977) 35|''Star Wars'' (1977) 35]]</ref>

Orman soon escaped Imperial custody and confronted Vader on the planet [[Monastery/Legends|Monastery]], ultimately dying in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] duel with Skywalker.<ref name="marvel37">[[Star Wars (1977) 37|''Star Wars'' (1977) 37]]</ref> Silas remained in the Empire's hands, where he eventually died&mdash;news of his passing was one of the factors that led Tagge's younger sister [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina]], who went on to become Baroness of the Tagge Company, to turn against Vader and the Imperials.<ref name="intrigue" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Orman's concern with family honor and personal vendettas is nothing to me. I'm a scientist. Having invented something... it's logical I should wish to see it used.|Silas Tagge|<ref name="marvel34" />}}
Although Silas Tagge was born into one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] richest and most powerful families, he was wholly uninterested in power, status or careerist ambitions: science was the man's life and his sole pursuit.<ref name="geonosis" /> Tagge's pursuit of his scientific goals was unencumbered either by material concerns&mdash;he dressed simply and ate only processed food substitutes such as [[Nutrient paste/Legends|nutrient pastes]]&mdash;or personal morality, as Tagge was a sociopath who was willing to make all sacrifices for his pursuits. That, in turn, led to a strident loyalty to TaggeCo, as it was the vessel through which Tagge could get his projects funded.<ref name="intrigue" />

Tagge worked closely with his brother Orman in his duties with TaggeCo, although Silas often looked down upon his older brother&mdash;he saw Orman as overly emotional and childish, deriding Orman's fixation with lightsaber training and penchant for eating real meat.<ref name="marvel31" /> Cold and logical, Silas still backed his brother despite having no interest in Orman's grudges and rivalries with men like Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader, although by 0 ABY he had started to show slight interest in assuming the title of Baron Tagge after his brother. However, Silas panicked when finally given a chance in charge, preferring the safety and stability of running experiments in his laboratory to all the unpredictable variables involved in leading a group in the field. In the end, Silas ran back to his brother, begging him to once again take command.<ref name="marvel34" />

==Behind the scenes==
Silas Tagge first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 31|''Star Wars'' (1977) 31]], written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and released in [[1980]]. He was featured several more times in the original [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel ''Star Wars'' comic line]], during which time he was illustrated by [[Carmine Infantino]].<ref name="marvel31" /> Tagge last appears in [[Star Wars (1977) 36|''Star Wars'' (1977) 36]], where he is depicted as being held in stasis by Darth Vader alongside his brother Orman after the destruction of the Omega Frost.<ref name="marvel36">[[Star Wars (1977) 36|''Star Wars'' (1977) 36]]</ref> Although Orman escapes and dies at Luke Skywalker's hand in [[Star Wars (1977) 37|''Star Wars'' (1977) 37]], Silas' fate is left unclear.<ref name="marvel37" /> The [[2010]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] supplement ''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]'' alludes to Silas' death in Imperial custody at some point after ''Star Wars 36'', although the timeframe and circumstances of the event are not given.<ref name="intrigue" />
